# Voice control script functions

Functions for C# (`Cb.Call`) and Python (a `cb` method each, or `cb.call`). See [Script functions](index.md) for how to use them.

![A Run Python code step in the action editor](../../assets/screens/actions-python-step.png)

## voiceControl.commands

Lists all your voice commands from the Voice Control page.

**Gives back:** A list of commands. Each has id, name, enabled, phrase (what to say), location (Exact, Start or Anywhere), stopAfter, overrideGlobal and confidenceThreshold (0-100).

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("voiceControl.commands");
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.voice_control_commands()
    ```

## voiceControl.dictationLog

Shows what voice control heard recently. Handy to see why a command did not run.

**Gives back:** A list of heard phrases. Each has time, text, confidencePercent (how sure it was, 0-100), commands (which ones ran) and ignored.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("voiceControl.dictationLog");
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.voice_control_dictation_log()
    ```

## voiceControl.inputDevices

Lists the microphones voice control can listen to.

**Gives back:** A list of microphones. Each has id, name and isDefault (true for your computer's default).

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("voiceControl.inputDevices");
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.voice_control_input_devices()
    ```

## voiceControl.isListening

Checks whether voice control is listening to your microphone right now.

**Gives back:** true while listening, otherwise false.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("voiceControl.isListening");
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.voice_control_is_listening()
    ```

## voiceControl.setCommand

Changes what you have to say for a voice command. Can also make a new command. Fails with an error when the command is not found (and create is off) or the phrase is empty.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `command` | `command` | The voice command's name or id, like "Switch to gameplay". |
| `phrase` | `phrase` | What you have to say, like "go to gameplay". Needed. |
| `location` | `location` | Optional. Where in what you say the phrase must be: "Exact" (all of it), "Start" or "Anywhere". Leave it out to keep it as it is. |
| `create` | `create` | Optional. true makes a new command with this name when none exists. Default false. |

**Gives back:** The command after the change, with the same details as voiceControl.commands.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("voiceControl.setCommand", new { command = "Switch to gameplay", phrase = "go to gameplay", location = "Anywhere" });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.voice_control_set_command(command="Switch to gameplay", phrase="go to gameplay", location="Anywhere")
    ```

## voiceControl.setCommandState

Turns one voice command on or off. Fails with an error when no command has that name.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `command` | `command` | The voice command's name or id, like "Switch to gameplay". |
| `state` | `state` | Optional. "Enabled", "Disabled" or "Toggle" (switch). Default "Toggle". |

**Gives back:** The new state: true for on, false for off.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("voiceControl.setCommandState", new { command = "Switch to gameplay", state = "Disabled" });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.voice_control_set_command_state(command="Switch to gameplay", state="Disabled")
    ```

## voiceControl.setInputDevice

Picks which microphone voice control listens to. The choice is saved.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `device` | `device` | The microphone's name or id from voiceControl.inputDevices. Empty or "Default" uses your computer's default microphone. |

**Gives back:** true when done.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("voiceControl.setInputDevice", new { device = "Default" });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.voice_control_set_input_device(device="Default")
    ```

## voiceControl.startListening

Starts listening to your microphone for voice commands. Fails with an error when no microphone or recognizer is available.

**Gives back:** true when it is listening now.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("voiceControl.startListening");
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.voice_control_start_listening()
    ```

## voiceControl.status

Tells you how voice control is doing right now.

**Gives back:** engine (the speech recognizer in use), state, message (a status line), listening (true/false) and inputDevice (the chosen microphone; empty means the default).

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("voiceControl.status");
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.voice_control_status()
    ```

## voiceControl.stopListening

Stops listening for voice commands.

**Gives back:** true when done.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("voiceControl.stopListening");
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.voice_control_stop_listening()
    ```
